fact: At May 2022 the Puntland EMIS was still under development and state-wide collection of attendance data was not in place; the open-source Digital Attendance Application, piloted by education NGOs in Puntland in 2019 and integrated with the GPE-supported Puntland EMIS, collects daily student and teacher attendance on mobile devices offline and uploads it to the EMIS server, and was being trialled in 42 schools, with the ministry proposing to expand it.
title: Education Emergency Response Programme: Programme Document
publisher: Puntland State of Somalia, Ministry of Education and Higher Education
